messages:
Mike (Sales): Quick handoff for Vanguardix — midmarket eCom analytics customer. Signed for Dedicated w/ EU residency requirement, 6mo commit starting 3/31. Need CS lead + eng/support owners.
Sara (CS): Hi — I'm Sara, I'll be CSM. Can you drop a short summary of infra and SSO needs here and confirm primary contacts?
Mike (Sales): TL;DR: Okta SAML SSO, VPN/CIDR for VPC peering, embedding-heavy (QPS ~40/min), avg 120 tokens/req. Contacts: Emma (PM) and Raj (Infra). Agreed: Dedicated pool + burst to hosted in peaks. Renewal risk = medium if latency or cost spikes in first 8 weeks.
Alex (Eng): Looping in eng — what region (EU region name) and do we have a diagram for their network topology? Also estimate: 3-5 eng days to provision and test Dedicated + VPN, +1 day for EU region prep.
Nora (Support): I'll be primary support. Please add me to contact list and onboarding channel. Also want SLOs we should monitor (latency, error rate, token cost anomalies).
Sara (CS): Next steps I'm proposing: (1) Mike intro Emma/Raj to this thread (today). (2) Vanguardix to provide Okta metadata + VPN CIDR by 3/28. (3) Eng to provision Dedicated pool + run smoke tests by 4/2. (4) CS to schedule kickoff 3/31 week. (5) Support to define alerting for latency >150ms or error rate >1%.
Mike (Sales): Intro sent to Emma & Raj — they acknowledged and said they'll upload SAML metadata EOD.
onboard-bot: Reminder created: kickoff meeting scheduled 2025-03-31 16:00 UTC.
Sara (CS): Capture for enablement: we need the prompt/eval set used in POC to establish baseline quality. Mike, can you share the prompt set and any eval metrics so CS can run weekly quality checks first 8 weeks?
Mike (Sales): Prompt set link: https://drive.redwood/vanguardix/promptset_v1. POC eval: embedding recall 86%, gen accuracy 91% on our validation; token mix is mostly short queries + occasional long summaries.
Alex (Eng): Recommend enabling KV prefix caching and 8-bit quantization for embeddings to control cost. I'll own eng reviews for any quality regressions first month. Add me to the eval sheet with edit access.
Nora (Support): Added a draft alerting policy to the ops doc: latency threshold 150ms (99th), error rate 1%, embedding QPS spike >200 triggers paging.
Sara (CS): I'll create a concise onboarding playbook and post to #cs-onboarding after kickoff. Also will set up a shared weekly sync (CS/Eng/Support) for first 6 weeks to capture feedback and regressions. :thumbsup:
Emma (Vanguardix): Thanks — I'm uploading Okta metadata this afternoon and will share a network diagram. Excited to get started.
